items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I’m thinking Buckner, but he was an organist, Milt Buckner. You said short and heavy. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Ask Mom.

ctx.x: No, real big. Short, heavy. He had Ron Jefferson and Leroy Vinnegar.
